nodes.label: Run bot
nodes.description: Runs a saved bot as one bounded agent turn.

nodes.label: Classify
nodes.description: One bounded model call that returns one of the declared labels.

nodes.label: Critique finding
nodes.description: One bounded model call that judges a finding against its evidence.

nodes.label: Delegate tasks
nodes.description: Runs up to six independent tasks as bounded agent turns.

nodes.label: Extract
nodes.description: One bounded model call that extracts a JSON object.

nodes.label: Plan steps
nodes.description: One bounded model call that proposes 1-8 independent steps.

nodes.label: Research agent
nodes.description: Runs a bounded agent turn and returns a structured finding.

nodes.label: Summarize
nodes.description: One bounded model call that compresses text, an array or an object.

nodes.label: Agent
nodes.description: Runs one bounded agent turn with a prompt, task, tools and memory.

nodes.label: Run committee
nodes.description: Runs the institution committee and returns its terminal decision.

nodes.label: Load dataset
nodes.description: Reads a dataset by reference. A missing or expired reference is an explicit failure.

nodes.label: Save dataset
nodes.description: Stores a JSON payload in the local dataset store and returns a small reference.

nodes.label: Extract field
nodes.description: Reads a dotted path out of an object or array.

nodes.label: File
nodes.description: Turns an uploaded local file into text or rows.

nodes.label: Export file
nodes.description: Exports rows to a downloadable local CSV, JSON or Excel file.

nodes.label: Parse file
nodes.description: Parses a file reference into rows, columns and text.

nodes.label: Parse JSON
nodes.description: Parses a JSON string into a structured object.

nodes.label: Set variables
nodes.description: Builds a named variables object from configuration and an optional input object.

nodes.label: Constant / input
nodes.description: Emits a literal value, or the value arriving on its input.

nodes.label: Typed decision
nodes.description: Ask choice / score / yes-no questions about a state and get typed answers.

nodes.label: Typed decision (demo)
nodes.description: Zero-config demonstration of a typed judgment — no key, no network.

nodes.label: Write file
nodes.description: Writes a payload inside a named, operator-configured scope.

nodes.label: Bond data
nodes.description: Reads price/yield and derives duration and convexity when inputs exist.

nodes.label: Funding rate
nodes.description: Reads a perpetual funding rate, optionally with its history.

nodes.label: FX rate
nodes.description: Reads a foreign-exchange rate (pair, or base + quote).

nodes.label: Historical prices
nodes.description: Reads gateway-backed OHLCV with provider provenance; feeds the indicator nodes.

nodes.label: Indicator
nodes.description: Computes a deterministic technical indicator.

nodes.label: Instrument
nodes.description: Resolves a symbol to its canonical identity through the data bridge.

nodes.label: Liquidations
nodes.description: Reads forced-liquidation totals for a coin on one futures exchange.

nodes.label: Long/short ratio
nodes.description: Reads the global long/short account ratio history for a futures pair.

nodes.label: Market cap
nodes.description: Reads market capitalisation and the share basis it uses.

nodes.label: Market data
nodes.description: Reads a price series via the existing data gateway + JDDS.

nodes.label: On-chain metrics
nodes.description: Reads account-scoped on-chain metrics for an EVM address.

nodes.label: Open interest
nodes.description: Reads futures open interest with native/derived field labels.

nodes.label: Options chain
nodes.description: Reads an options chain; Greeks are provider-sourced or calculated, never zero-filled.

nodes.label: Order book
nodes.description: Reads the top-of-book depth and spread through the market gateway.

nodes.label: Live quote
nodes.description: Reads a live quote through the existing market gateway, with provenance.

nodes.label: Crypto supply
nodes.description: Reads circulating/total/max supply and FDV for a crypto asset.

nodes.label: Trade tape
nodes.description: Reads recent trades (with provider or inferred side) from the gateway.

nodes.label: DeFi TVL
nodes.description: Reads total value locked for a protocol or chain.

nodes.label: Volume stats
nodes.description: Reads windowed volume with native/derived field labels.

nodes.label: For each
nodes.description: Runs a pinned body workflow once per array item, up to a hard cap.

nodes.label: Gate
nodes.description: Runs only when its control input fires — the if/else branch primitive.

nodes.label: Parallel map
nodes.description: Runs a pinned body workflow once per item, concurrently and bounded.

nodes.label: Repeat
nodes.description: Runs a pinned body workflow N times, passing the previous output on.

nodes.label: Subworkflow
nodes.description: Runs a pinned saved workflow as a nested run with the same grants.

nodes.label: While
nodes.description: Runs a pinned body workflow while a safe numeric condition holds.

nodes.label: Analyze image
nodes.description: One bounded vision read: describe, answer, ground or extract JSON.

nodes.label: Image
nodes.description: Uploads or references one local image.

nodes.label: Read image options
nodes.description: Applies the same questions to 1–8 images, one result per image.

nodes.label: Compare images
nodes.description: Compares two images (pixel diff and/or visual description).

nodes.label: Read text (OCR)
nodes.description: Extracts text and pixel spans from an image.

nodes.label: Read chart
nodes.description: Reads a chart image into trend, patterns, candles and levels.

nodes.label: HTTP request
nodes.description: Calls an external HTTP endpoint. Egress is default-deny.

nodes.label: HTTP request
nodes.description: Calls an external HTTP endpoint with query, body modes, retries and bounded responses.

nodes.label: Send webhook
nodes.description: POSTs a JSON payload with an HMAC-SHA256 webhook signature.

nodes.label: Aggregate / group
nodes.description: Numeric aggregate, optionally grouped by dotted fields.

nodes.label: Assert
nodes.description: Fails the run with a named message when the condition is not met.

nodes.label: If / else
nodes.description: Routes control flow on a declared comparison.

nodes.label: Deduplicate
nodes.description: Keeps the first row per key, or per whole row when keys is empty.

nodes.label: Fallback
nodes.description: Returns the first present input and which port it came from.

nodes.label: Filter
nodes.description: Keeps numeric items whose formula result is non-zero.

nodes.label: Wait for approval
nodes.description: Pauses until an operator approves (or denies) this step.

nodes.label: Map
nodes.description: Evaluates a formula for each numeric item (vars: value, index).

nodes.label: Merge
nodes.description: Joins two branches back into one value.

nodes.label: Reduce
nodes.description: Accumulates numeric items (vars: acc, value, index).

nodes.label: Stop
nodes.description: Ends the run here; downstream nodes are skipped.

nodes.label: Switch
nodes.description: Fires `matched` or `default` and reports the case index.

nodes.label: Wait
nodes.description: Pauses for a bounded time; a durable run defers the job instead of blocking.

nodes.label: Memory context
nodes.description: Builds a deterministic, budgeted memory prompt block.

nodes.label: Forget memory
nodes.description: Soft-forgets (archives) one memory record.

nodes.label: List memories
nodes.description: Browses stored memories by scope, type and status.

nodes.label: Recall memory
nodes.description: Reads the app memory service into the graph.

nodes.label: Remember
nodes.description: Writes one durable memory record.

nodes.label: Update memory
nodes.description: Corrects one memory record.

nodes.label: Chart
nodes.description: Builds a chart spec (and its figure) from a payload.

nodes.label: Notify
nodes.description: Sends one message through a configured channel.

nodes.label: Result
nodes.description: Terminal node — captures the workflow result.

nodes.label: Align instruments
nodes.description: Aligns several instruments onto one timestamp axis with an explicit join and fill.

nodes.label: Backtest
nodes.description: Runs a deterministic backtest through the existing quant engine.

nodes.label: Benchmark comparison
nodes.description: Alpha, beta, tracking error and information ratio against a benchmark series.

nodes.label: Beta & alpha
nodes.description: CAPM beta and annualized alpha against a benchmark.

nodes.label: Correlation
nodes.description: Pairwise correlation over the shared finite points, with an optional window.

nodes.label: Transaction costs
nodes.description: One cost family over an order list, with the exact model made auditable.

nodes.label: Drawdown
nodes.description: Computes the underwater curve and max/current drawdown.

nodes.label: Edge report
nodes.description: Grades a backtest artifact and renders the Markdown report with its charts.

nodes.label: Continuous futures
nodes.description: Splices ordered contracts at roll dates into one back-adjusted series.

nodes.label: Edge verdict
nodes.description: Grades the evidence behind an edge: an A–F verdict with components and flags.

nodes.label: Monte Carlo
nodes.description: Stress-tests a strategy through the existing Monte Carlo engine.

nodes.label: Overfitting check
nodes.description: Deflated Sharpe and Probability of Backtest Overfitting for a selected strategy.

nodes.label: Out-of-sample evaluation
nodes.description: Splits the series chronologically and compares in-sample with out-of-sample.

nodes.label: Optimize parameters
nodes.description: Searches a parameter grid through the existing quant optimizer.

nodes.label: Options strategy
nodes.description: Multi-leg expiry payoff, break-evens and boundedness, with Greeks when supplied.

nodes.label: Portfolio backtest
nodes.description: Runs several strategies on one shared book over a {symbol: OHLCV} map.

nodes.label: Position size
nodes.description: Computes a position size with the engine’s own PositionSizing contract.

nodes.label: Regime labels
nodes.description: Labels every bar trend × volatility through the existing regime classifier.

nodes.label: Resample OHLCV
nodes.description: Aggregates bars into a wider interval with documented, partial-marked buckets.

nodes.label: Returns
nodes.description: Simple or log returns of a series over a period.

nodes.label: Risk metrics
nodes.description: Computes volatility, Sharpe/Sortino, drawdown, VaR/CVaR, skew and kurtosis.

nodes.label: Robustness
nodes.description: Parameter sensitivity, cost sensitivity, concentration and regime splits → a verdict.

nodes.label: Trade analysis
nodes.description: Reads a trade log against the regime, trend and volatility at each entry.

nodes.label: Volatility
nodes.description: Rolling standard deviation of log returns, optionally annualized.

nodes.label: Walk-forward
nodes.description: Rolling train/test validation with out-of-sample metrics.

nodes.label: Z-score
nodes.description: Rolling standard score of a series.

nodes.label: Audit citations
nodes.description: Checks that every material claim is traceable to honest citations.

nodes.label: Citations & claims
nodes.description: Reads citations and claims for a research run.

nodes.label: Verify claim
nodes.description: Verifies one claim against stored evidence with the existing verifier.

nodes.label: Verify claims (batch)
nodes.description: Verifies many claims with the run’s conflicts and point-in-time rules.

nodes.label: Completeness check
nodes.description: Summarizes coverage, supported claims, citations and unresolved conflicts.

nodes.label: Scan conflicts
nodes.description: Runs the deterministic conflict detector over evidence.

nodes.label: Conflicts
nodes.description: Reads stored source conflicts for a research run.

nodes.label: Run research engine
nodes.description: Runs the existing research engine end to end and returns its run id.

nodes.label: Compare runs
nodes.description: Compares two runs answering the same question.

nodes.label: Entities & relations
nodes.description: Reads the evidence-anchored entity and relation graph.

nodes.label: Retrieve evidence
nodes.description: Reads stored evidence for a research run, with an optional text filter.

nodes.label: Extract facts
nodes.description: Model-assisted, span-validated financial fact extraction.

nodes.label: Fetch pages
nodes.description: Fetches a known list of URLs through the SSRF-hardened bridge.

nodes.label: Point-in-time filter
nodes.description: Partitions evidence into admissible and rejected by as-of/freshness.

nodes.label: Coverage gaps
nodes.description: Names unanswered questions, rejected claims and uncited claims.

nodes.label: Ingest external research
nodes.description: Normalizes agent/MCP/manual evidence, claims and sources into the store.

nodes.label: Resolve research run
nodes.description: Resolves an exact research id or the newest run matching a question.

nodes.label: Quality score
nodes.description: Aggregates the engine’s explainable research-quality score.

nodes.label: Plan search queries
nodes.description: Expands a question, gaps and weak claims into search queries.

nodes.label: Research report
nodes.description: Builds a deterministic Markdown report from the stored research graph.

nodes.label: Collect table / records
nodes.description: Collects table/record rows from one page without a model.

nodes.label: Snapshot run
nodes.description: Freezes selected sections of a run into an immutable snapshot.

nodes.label: Rank evidence
nodes.description: Ranks evidence by the confidence and freshness it already carries.

nodes.label: Sources
nodes.description: Reads stored sources with domain, type and date filters.

nodes.label: Start research run
nodes.description: Creates the run row a cold graph needs; idempotent per question.

nodes.label: Revision chain
nodes.description: Builds the restatement/amendment chain from recorded revision metadata.

nodes.label: Crawl site
nodes.description: Crawls a bounded set of same-site pages from one start URL.

nodes.label: Fetch page
nodes.description: Fetches one page through the SSRF-hardened web bridge and returns its text.

nodes.label: Web search
nodes.description: Searches the web through the configured provider chain.

nodes.label: Run skill
nodes.description: Runs an installed skill through the existing skill runtime.

nodes.label: Commit playbook
nodes.description: Appends a playbook version the risk gate enforces; operator run only.

nodes.label: Improve playbook
nodes.description: Runs a seeded recursive climb and ranks playbook variants out-of-sample.

nodes.label: Journal trades
nodes.description: Loads a bounded window of journal trades and their execution log.

nodes.label: Learn from review
nodes.description: Records findings, counts recurrence and drafts inert lesson candidates.

nodes.label: Read playbook
nodes.description: Reads the active risk envelope and its version history.

nodes.label: Review trades
nodes.description: Finds process mistakes with deterministic detectors and names the field.

nodes.label: Await fill
nodes.description: Waits for a ledger order to reach a terminal state or the deadline.

nodes.label: Bracket
nodes.description: Direction-aware stop and target from an ATR multiple or explicit distance.

nodes.label: Break even
nodes.description: Moves the stop to entry after triggerR. Risk-reducing.

nodes.label: Broker account
nodes.description: Reads the broker account envelope for a connection.

nodes.label: Broker bars
nodes.description: The broker's own OHLCV series for symbols JDDS cannot proxy, with a derived ATR.

nodes.label: Cancel order
nodes.description: Cancels one working order. Risk-reducing.

nodes.label: Close position
nodes.description: Closes one position (full/partial), a whole symbol, or all positions. Risk-reducing.

nodes.label: Broker fills
nodes.description: Broker deals from Eclipse's reconciled history.

nodes.label: Modify position
nodes.description: Moves SL/TP on one position. Risk-reducing.

nodes.label: Modify order
nodes.description: Re-prices or re-brackets a working (pending) order. Risk-reducing.

nodes.label: Broker order
nodes.description: Submit one order to a broker connection under a bounded, revocable mandate.

nodes.label: Broker orders
nodes.description: The broker's own working (pending) orders.

nodes.label: Broker positions
nodes.description: The broker's open positions as rows.

nodes.label: Broker quote
nodes.description: Bid/ask/spread from the broker, including symbols JDDS may not carry.

nodes.label: Broker symbol
nodes.description: Static symbol facts (trade mode, contract, volume limits) — no tick needed.

nodes.label: Drift check
nodes.description: Compares the order ledger with the broker mirror and reports drift.

nodes.label: Order intent
nodes.description: Builds the validated order intent the execution adapters read.

nodes.label: Order ledger
nodes.description: Eclipse's own submitted-order ledger, newest first.

nodes.label: Order preview
nodes.description: Would this order be allowed? Broker check, policy, guardrails, mandate — nothing sent.

nodes.label: Paper account
nodes.description: Reads the durable PAPER account: cash, positions, realized PnL.

nodes.label: Paper order
nodes.description: PAPER-only execution adapter: simulates a fill at the supplied price.

nodes.label: Paper valuation
nodes.description: Marks the PAPER book to prices you supply (equity, unrealized PnL).

nodes.label: Partial close
nodes.description: Closes a fraction or an explicit volume of one position. Risk-reducing.

nodes.label: Reconcile
nodes.description: Refreshes the durable broker mirror (deals, positions, sync state).

nodes.label: Risk check
nodes.description: Pure pre-trade gate: reduces or rejects an order against the risk limits.

nodes.label: Session filter
nodes.description: UTC clock window plus the broker trade mode. Open or closed.

nodes.label: Size by risk
nodes.description: Volume from an equity risk budget, a stop distance and contract size.

nodes.label: Spread guard
nodes.description: Blocks a trade while the broker spread is wider than the cap.

nodes.label: Trail stop
nodes.description: Tightens the stop behind price, never widening risk.

nodes.label: Formula
nodes.description: Evaluates a bounded arithmetic expression over numeric inputs.

nodes.label: Join rows
nodes.description: Inner, left, right, full or anti join of two arrays of objects on dotted keys.

nodes.label: Select fields
nodes.description: Selects and renames columns in an array of objects.

nodes.label: Sort / limit
nodes.description: Sorts rows by dotted keys (or the whole row) and optionally limits them.

nodes.label: Template
nodes.description: Renders a string template from its inputs.

nodes.label: Manual trigger
nodes.description: Starts a run when a user executes the workflow by hand.

nodes.label: Schedule
nodes.description: Starts a run on a timezone-aware cron schedule.

nodes.label: Webhook
nodes.description: Starts a run from a verified inbound HTTP webhook.

nodes.label: Video render
nodes.description: Builds a data-bound market-recap storyboard and queues the native video render.
